def pairs_to_numbers(pairs):
    result = []
    for pair in pairs:
        number = (pair[0] - pair[1]) * (pair[0] + pair[1]) * (pair[0] + pair[1] - 10) * (pair[0] + pair[1] + 10)
        result.append(number)
    return result
